newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hwa Hong in China chemical joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Hwa Hong in China chemical joint venture.

text.p: Hwa Hong Corp Ltd said on Friday it was investing Singapore $4.95 million via its wholly-owned unit Hwa Hong Edible Oil Industries Pte Ltd (HHEO) in a joint venture chemical company in China.

Hwa Hong said in a statement the venture, Norwest Holdings Pte Ltd, would participate with Sichuan Mianzhu Elemental Phosphate Plant to set up a firm to make, refine, distribute and market phosphate chemicals.
The deal was conditional upon government and regulatory approval, it said.
Hwa Hong would provide management services to the venture.

Hwa Hong said its equity interest in Norwest was 49.5 percent and would be funded by internal resources. It did not expect the deal to have a material effect on its earnings per share for the financial year ending December 31, 1996.
